captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a bicycle power-meter crankset. It features a central dark cylindrical bottom-bracket shell, a large black multi-toothed single chainring with a power-meter spider, and two grey-toned hollow-forged crank arms extending in opposite directions. At the end of each crank arm, a black rectangular clipless pedal is attached via a silver metallic axle. The entire crank assembly rotates continuously around the bottom-bracket spindle, while each pedal rotates continuously on its axle and is capable of tilting on a revolute float joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a bicycle power-meter crankset with continuous rotation. The assembly should include a central bottom-bracket shell, a black multi-toothed chainring, two opposing grey-toned crank arms, and rectangular black pedals on axles that can rotate and tilt.
captions.factory: The code constructs the assembly starting with a fixed base representing the bottom-bracket shell using cylinder primitives. It then models a rotating spindle/crank assembly using continuous joints, combining extruded multi-toothed profiles for the chainring, circular plates for the spider, and swept or lofted profiles for the two crank arms. The pedals are modeled using box primitives for the bodies and cylinders for the axles, connected to the crank arms via nested continuous and revolute joints to simulate pedal spin and float.
